units: <cite ref="Chullin 20b:10">Ḥull. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>מצות ה׳</he> the law ordering the separation of the head from the body (<cite ref="Leviticus 1:15">Lev. I, 15</cite>).
<cite ref="Leviticus 1:15">Ib.</cite> <he>ישנו בה׳</he> must be cut apart; a. fr.
Gen. R. s. 3 ויבדל ה׳ ממש vayyabdel (Gen. I, 4) means real separation (in space, not logical differentiation).
<cite ref="Chagigah 15a:4">Ḥag. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ … דהואי</he> the separation (of the waters) took place on the second day.

senses.gloss: Habdalah, a formula of prayer for the exit of the Sabbath or Festivals, v. אַבְדָּלָה.
units: Ber. VIII, 5; a. fr.—Pl. הַבְדָּלוֹת the distinctions referred to in the Habdalah.
<cite ref="Chullin 26b:18">Ḥull. 26ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Pesachim 104a:7">Pes. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>סדר ה׳</he> the order of the subjects of distinction.
<cite ref="Pesachim 104a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>מעין ה׳ האמורות וכ׳</he> corresponding to the distinctions mentioned in the Bible (<cite ref="Leviticus 10:10">Lev. X, 10</cite> &c.).
